title: Adding `IsVerifiedDomain` to the `AzureADTenant` module
summary: The Azure AD Tenant module now includes a method to check if a domain is verified in the tenant's list of verified domains, retrieved from Microsoft Graph.
key_points: New IsVerifiedDomain method on codeunit Azure AD Tenant checks whether a domain is among the tenant's verified domains
Verified domains come from the Graph /organization endpoint data
Part of the skip review for trusted senders work
Depends on a LicensingService change; without it the verified domain list is empty (no crash), so use only after full roll-out
quote: Allows a consumer to validate whether a given domain is in the list of verified domains of a tenant
